Another useful way to use the Bid-Ask Spread: estimating real-world slippage.

The spread is simply the distance between the best bid and best ask.

For example, on BTC:

Best Bid: $63,561.07
Best Ask: $63,561.08
Spread: $0.01

Now imagine the liquidity at $63,561.08 disappears and the next best ask is $63,568.07.

The spread is now $7.00.

A market buy that would have previously filled near $63,561.08 now has to cross roughly $7 further just to reach the next available ask.

This matters for both live trading and historical backtesting.

At Hyblock, you can combine:

→ Bid-Ask Spread to measure the distance between the best prices

→ Bids & Asks with Depth = Quote to measure the actual bid and ask size available at those nearest prices

Together, these give you a much better picture of executable liquidity rather than just looking at price.

You can use the data to study potential slippage, compare execution conditions across exchanges, or make historical backtests more realistic.

What most data providers can't tell you because they simply do not have this much historical data at this level of granularity.

At 15:27 utc ~66m short liquidated in a singular 1min candle, across 41 liquidations. 

now technically, binance reports 1 force-order per second on the symbol, not per side. So the max count possible in a minute is 60. 

On every single 1 minute candle over the last 3 years (which by the way is 1.5m+ candles) on binance stablecoin perp, this one ranked #4. 

Only 5 other minutes ever had shortLiqCount ≥ 41, and the other four were sub-$1M (!). 

Now in terms of size, $66.8M shorts is #3 in 3 years. Only two 1m bars were larger, and only three minutes ever printed ≥$50M of Binance USDT-M short liqs. 

The reason why this liq event is so special is because we are seeing for the first time on binance stablecoin perp, a very high liq count (41 out of 60 possible liq events they can publish) AND a very high liq size. 

^assuming there were many liq events during each second (due to the quick price spike), the actual size may be much larger than reported. since 41 out of the 60 slots were taken.
